prompts.fuel: Four phases of a raging irregular spilled-fuel fire: asymmetric branching lobes, vigorous upward flames, molten rivulets, detached embers, transparent gaps; no round disk or geometric base. Transparent RGBA, 2x2 sheet.
prompts.flow: Reference-matched four phases of broad meandering burning-liquid rivulets merging neighboring fires, with soft branching ends, irregular edges and changing eddies; no rectangle or straight bar. Transparent RGBA, 2x2 sheet.
prompts.smoke: Reference-matched four phases of a rising curling charcoal/brown plume, narrow origin, thinning upper wisps, soft translucent alpha and subtle amber illumination; no round opaque puff. Transparent RGBA, 2x2 sheet.

packing: Fixed 2x2 source cells resized into four horizontal frames with 4px transparent gutters. Original alpha preserved. No procedural fire, filled bed, perimeter mask or rectangle composite.
rendering: Four independently phased patches plus three overlapping liquid-fuel flows at rank 5. Ground pivots from shared metadata. Flame tips overhang unchanged collision. Cross-fades, smoke drift and flicker use combat elapsed time only; deterministic per-cast phase variation never consumes combat RNG. Reduced Motion keeps complete fire/flow composition.
